regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with light-beige stone walls featuring horizontal banding and crisp white trim. The complex roofline features dark shingles and multiple gables with decorative white trusses. On the image-right, a gabled porch with white columns and a sunburst-patterned truss shelters a white front door. A set of gray stairs with black railings and white posts leads up to this porch. Windows are white-framed with multi-pane grids; three are visible on the upper level and four on the lower level, some glowing with warm interior light. A white horizontal band separates the two floors. The house sits on a light gray foundation over a flat green lawn.

regions.label: <multi-gabled roof 1>
regions.prompt: Multi-gabled roof with dark charcoal shingles and thick white fascia boards. Two prominent forward-facing gables feature white decorative truss patterns with vertical and diagonal braces in their peaks. The gable on the image-left sits above a small white-framed window, while the larger gable on the image-right covers a set of three white-framed windows. A lower, horizontal roof section with matching dark shingles extends across the bottom center, sheltering a porch area. All roof edges are sharply defined by the white trim against the dark textured shingles.

regions.label: <porch 1>
regions.prompt: Front porch with a gabled dark-shingled roof and a white decorative sunburst truss in the gable peak. Two square white columns with decorative capitals support the roof, resting on a light-gray stone foundation. A white front door with six glass panes and a black handle is recessed behind the columns. Black railings with thin vertical balusters line the porch edge and the light-gray concrete steps leading up to it. The railings are punctuated by white square posts with pyramid-shaped caps. To the image-right, the house wall features light-beige stone with horizontal banding and two white-trimmed windows.

regions.label: <stairs 1>
regions.prompt: A set of light-gray concrete stairs leading up to a porch landing. The stairs are flanked by black metal railings with thin vertical spindles. White square wooden posts with pyramid-shaped caps anchor the railings at the base of the stairs, the landing, and the top of the first flight. The landing and stairs are part of a house with a light-gray textured foundation and light-beige stone walls with horizontal banding visible in the background.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Three identical, side-by-side vertical rectangular windows set into a light-beige stone wall with horizontal banding. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into twelve small panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-four grid. The glass panes are dark grey with subtle vertical reflections.

regions.label: <window 2>
regions.prompt: A trio of identical, vertically oriented rectangular windows set side-by-side. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into nine smaller panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-three grid. The glass panes are dark gray with subtle vertical reflections. The windows are mounted against a wall of light-beige stone with horizontal banding.

regions.label: <window 3>
regions.prompt: White-framed rectangular window with six panes arranged in two columns and three rows, separated by thin white muntins. The glass panes are dark and non-reflective. A thick white sill projects slightly from the bottom of the frame against a background of light-beige stone with horizontal banding.

regions.label: <window 6>
regions.prompt: Vertical rectangular window with a thick white frame and sill, set against light-beige stone with horizontal banding. The window is divided into two sashes: the top sash contains six panes in a three-by-two grid glowing with warm yellow light, while the bottom sash contains six dark panes in a matching three-by-two grid.

regions.label: <window 7>
regions.prompt: Tall, narrow rectangular window with a thick white frame and prominent sill, set against light-beige stone with horizontal banding. The window is divided vertically; the image-left pane glows with a warm golden light and is subdivided by thin white muntins, while the image-right pane is a single, dark grey glass surface.

regions.label: <plain 1>
regions.prompt: A flat, grassy plain. A long shadow is cast onto the grass at the image-left.

regions.label: <shadow 1>
regions.prompt: A dark, elongated shadow cast across a textured, olive-green grassy field. The shadow's upper edge forms a large, solid geometric block that angles from the top-left towards the center. Below this, thinner, parallel horizontal bands of shadow stretch across the lower half of the crop, with the bottom-most band featuring a serrated, comb-like edge on its right side.

regions.label: <sky 1>
regions.prompt: Clear, pale blue sky with a subtle horizontal gradient, transitioning from a slightly deeper blue at the top to a very pale, almost white hue near the horizon line. The sky is completely cloudless and uniform in texture.

layout.prompt: A 3d_render of a two-story <house 1> with a traditional architectural style, presented from a high-angle perspective against a minimalist background. The <house 1> features a multi-gabled roof covered in dark grey shingles. The exterior walls are finished in a light beige, textured stone or siding with horizontal banding. A prominent white-trimmed porch with a gabled roof and decorative trusses extends from the front, supported by square white columns. A set of grey stairs with black railings and white posts leads up to the porch. The <house 1> has numerous white-framed windows with multi-pane glass. On the upper floor, a set of three windows is grouped under one gable, and a single window is positioned under another. On the lower floor, a pair of windows is visible on the left side, and another pair is on the right side under the porch. Additional smaller windows are scattered across the facade. The <house 1> sits on a vast, flat green <plain 1> that stretches to the horizon under a clear, pale blue <sky 1>. A long, dark <shadow 1> cast by the <house 1> extends across the <plain 1> to the image-left, indicating a light source from the image-right.
